messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Canary cohort for featuregate `prompt-routing-v2` showing 18% 5xx in the last 3 minutes (baseline 0.4%). Autoscaling OK. Investigating telemetry lag. Paging @jules (oncall).

jules: I'm on it. can someone grab the runbook link for featuregate issues?

priya: Runbook is here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ff-rollouts. quick summary: we can toggle the FF to 'off' with `rbq featuregate set prompt-routing-v2 false --env=prod` and there's a fast rollback endpoint in the ops console.

mike: seeing a spike in incomplete responses from the new endpoint (prompt-proxy-v2). stack traces point to 502 from the proxy layer, not the model nodes. logs: ```proxy/error - upstream reset by peer - route /v1/prompt/proxy/stream```

jules: ok prio: disable the gate then confirm observability. priya, can you flip it? I'll coordinate comms.

priya: flipping now. running: `rbq featuregate set prompt-routing-v2 false --actor=priya --reason="canary 5xx spike"`

deploy-bot: FeatureGate prompt-routing-v2 toggled OFF by priya @ 3087660001. Audited.

jules: seeing error rate drop to 2.2% within 40s. p95 latency still elevated in eu-west-1 though. looks like some cached connections need draining. :eyes:

vera: I'll run a connection drain on the proxy pool in eu-west-1. `opsctl drain proxy-pool --region eu-west-1 --grace=30s`

mike: after the drain p95 moved down ~600ms -> ~120ms. Incomplete responses stopped. I'm rechecking logs for any lingering 502s.

cs-ops: Heads up — two customers reported garbled outputs during the window. I've opened tickets and messaged affected accounts (alpha-customers). Suggested message: "We experienced degraded responses for <timestamp-window>. We've disabled the experimental routing and are monitoring. We'll follow up with a root cause and timeline." Want approval to send?

jules: go ahead. keep the tone "we mitigated" but offer a follow-up postmortem. assign to me and priya for follow-up.

priya: creating a postmortem draft and adding immediate action items: 1) Add more aggressive early-detection thresholds for canaries. 2) Add a non-disruptive circuit to drop new-route traffic earlier. 3) Verify proxy connection pooling behavior for the new endpoint.

vera: I'll add an ops play to the runbook for forced connection drains and include the `--grace` knobs we used.

jules: handing off to vera for the watch window. I'm going offline but will check in at +30. vera, take the pager for the next 45m. priya/mike, follow-up on logs and correlate with tracing.

vera: ack. taking over pager. I'll post updates if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident annotated: severity=sev2, summary="Canary 5xx spike on prompt-routing-v2 -> featuregate toggled off", responders=[jules, priya, vera], incident_id=INC-2026-118. Timeline snapshot saved.

jules: quick note for the postmortem: include customer impact counts, exact toggle timestamps from deploy-bot audit log, and the proxy pool host IDs that exhibited connection resets. Also estimate work to add earlier kill-switch automation.

priya: copied. will attach logs + a short repro of the proxy reset when I have it.

mike: leaving a trace link: https://traces.redwood/internal/trace/0ac4f7 - shows concentrated errors from proxy-node-17 and -19.

cs-ops: Customer notifications sent. two customers acknowledged and asked for ETA; offered follow-up once postmortem ready.

vera: all clear for now, no new alerts in the last 10m. keeping the watch; will escalate to on-call immediately if error rate >5% again.

jules: thanks everyone. postmortem owners: jules (lead), priya (technical), vera (ops). closing active mitigation, leaving watch to vera.
